name: White
source:
Main character has been longing for his sempai, and she finally accepts his feelings. She has strange hobbies like cosplay, but he likes her even in embarrassing situations.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]

主角一直渴望他的前辈，她终于接受了他的感情。她有cosplay等奇怪的爱好，但即使在尴尬的情况下，他也喜欢她。
